versions.content: GlobalTimeDomain . pduTriggering is not required on Eth- ernet The Pdu for transmitting global time information is not required on the Ethernet bus. Here, the information is accessed directly from the Ethernet Interfaces, i.e. the hardware already keeps track of the global time.
